name: Eventtia MCP
description:
The Eventtia MCP connector lets Claude interact directly with the Eventtia event management platform, covering the full event lifecycle:

Events — Create and update events, list all events, and retrieve event details, summaries, enabled modules, and event-level custom fields. Includes city search for setting event locations.

Attendees & Registration — Register new attendees, update their information, look up individual attendees, and list all attendees for an event. Supports the approval workflow (confirm or reject attendees), resending registration emails, and checking an attendee's event check-in status.

Attendee Types & Forms — Create and manage attendee types (categories/tickets), define and update custom registration fields per attendee type, retrieve registration form schemas, and view group registration limits.

Agenda & Sessions — Create, update, retrieve, and delete sessions, plus enroll or unenroll attendees in specific sessions.

Workshops — Create, update, and list workshops, retrieve workshop details and attendance statistics, and view attendee workshop check-ins.

Speakers — Create, update, list, and retrieve speaker profiles.

Check-in & Access Control — Create, update, and delete checkpoints (v4), and list attendee check-ins at checkpoints for on-site access tracking.

Payments — Create, list, and delete payment records tied to registrations.

In short: it turns Claude into an operational assistant for Eventtia — able to set up events, build registration forms, manage attendees end-to-end (register → confirm → check in), run agendas, workshops, and speakers, and handle payments, all conversationally.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Eventtia MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Eventtia MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://connect-mcp.eventtia.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Eventtia MCP MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Eventtia MCP lists 49 MCP tools, including confirmAttendee, createAttendee, createAttendeeType, createAttendeeTypeCustomField, createCheckpointV4, createEvent, createPayment, createSession, createSpeaker, createWorkshop, deleteCheckpointV4, and deletePayment.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Eventtia MCP?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Eventtia MCP in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Eventtia MCP MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Eventtia MCP requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Eventtia MCP is developed by Eventtia Inc. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
